89b05d1cd8f314d4bd2a.en: Two vowels can team up to make one long sound.
89b05d1cd8f314d4bd2a.id: Dua huruf vokal (vowel) bisa bekerja sama membuat satu bunyi panjang.

cb5e7fa95790e0323d21.en: Ai says a, like in rain and tail.
cb5e7fa95790e0323d21.id: Ai berbunyi a, seperti pada rain dan tail.

d4946db83f4d11fcb9d9.en: Ee says e, like in tree. Oa says o, like in boat.
d4946db83f4d11fcb9d9.id: Ee berbunyi e, seperti pada tree. Oa berbunyi o, seperti pada boat.

414d106000ff5f877969.en: Igh has three letters. It says i, like in night.
414d106000ff5f877969.id: Igh punya tiga huruf. Bunyinya i, seperti pada night.

83d6143ab82b2b88d30c.en: Oo says oo, like in moon and food.
83d6143ab82b2b88d30c.id: Oo berbunyi oo, seperti pada moon dan food.

126213b9e96f0d6448e8.en: Coat has oa. It says the long o sound.
126213b9e96f0d6448e8.id: Coat punya oa. Bunyinya o panjang.

ddca6a4c29da796b17dd.en: Rain is spelt r, ai, n. The letters a and i make one long sound.
ddca6a4c29da796b17dd.id: Rain dieja r, ai, n. Huruf a dan i membentuk satu bunyi panjang.

0086a07118b112510346.en: That would say reen. Say the picture name again.
0086a07118b112510346.id: Itu akan berbunyi reen. Ucapkan lagi nama gambarnya.

43e4140cb0cc23212a22.en: That would say roan. Say the picture name again.
43e4140cb0cc23212a22.id: Itu akan berbunyi roan. Ucapkan lagi nama gambarnya.

3d8bce59d2297a472921.en: Tree has ee. The two e letters make one long sound.
3d8bce59d2297a472921.id: Tree punya ee. Dua huruf e itu membentuk satu bunyi panjang.

40e6df5af04fb464833f.en: Boat is spelt b, oa, t. Oa makes the long o sound.
40e6df5af04fb464833f.id: Boat dieja b, oa, t. Oa membentuk bunyi o panjang.

16c1315c058136cb0f99.en: Light has igh. The three letters make one long i sound.
16c1315c058136cb0f99.id: Light punya igh. Tiga huruf itu membentuk satu bunyi i panjang.

91fb6a1c02b1f6893141.en: Rain, tail and snail have ai. Feet, seed and green have ee.
91fb6a1c02b1f6893141.id: Rain, tail, dan snail punya ai. Feet, seed, dan green punya ee.

76267964c7eb86764415.en: Moon has oo in the middle. The two o letters make one long sound.
76267964c7eb86764415.id: Moon punya oo di tengah. Dua huruf o itu membentuk satu bunyi panjang.

cd986ce28c770296578e.en: Man has a short a sound.

b99649e3314708ec50f2.en: Mud has a short u sound.

d17e86a1ac3aaa30617a.en: Tail has ai, feet has ee, high has igh, coat has oa and food has oo.
d17e86a1ac3aaa30617a.id: Tail punya ai, feet punya ee, high punya igh, coat punya oa, dan food punya oo.

9406d1ed9602a6986a9c.en: Tree is spelt t, r, ee. The long e at the end is ee.
9406d1ed9602a6986a9c.id: Tree dieja t, r, ee. Bunyi e panjang di akhir kata ditulis ee.

5dd1709ee1e65f81ed48.en: The moon is in the night sky. Boat and soap do not make sense here.
5dd1709ee1e65f81ed48.id: The moon is in the night sky. Boat dan soap tidak cocok di sini.

20d0f1bcf4a5343fc382.en: A boat is on the water.

75b035e8f6272fdbf7d0.en: Food, zoo and spoon have oo. Boat has oa and seed has ee.
75b035e8f6272fdbf7d0.id: Food, zoo, dan spoon punya oo. Boat punya oa dan seed punya ee.

0b8f3dafbdbf7e5926bb.en: Night is spelt n, igh, t. The letters igh make the long i sound.
0b8f3dafbdbf7e5926bb.id: Night dieja n, igh, t. Huruf igh membentuk bunyi i panjang.

527f92584505014dc0f1.en: This is not the right spelling. The long i here uses three letters.
527f92584505014dc0f1.id: Ini bukan ejaan yang benar. Bunyi i panjang di sini memakai tiga huruf.

25c089e65f541a5f52f8.en: This is not how we spell it in English.
25c089e65f541a5f52f8.id: Bukan begitu cara mengejanya dalam bahasa Inggris.

2a8861f562ad00209b37.en: Goat with b at the start is boat. A boat floats on water.
2a8861f562ad00209b37.id: Goat dengan b di awal menjadi boat. Boat (perahu) mengapung di air.

5a74292aaf716494fac4.en: You wear a coat. It does not float on water.
5a74292aaf716494fac4.id: Kamu memakai coat. Coat tidak mengapung di air.

b6ff4ff5a49fbaccfd80.en: Goal changes the last letter, not the first.
b6ff4ff5a49fbaccfd80.id: Goal mengubah huruf terakhir, bukan huruf pertama.

75fd24bb3496fe2ae6d8.en: Feet are at the end of your legs. Feet has ee in the middle.
75fd24bb3496fe2ae6d8.id: Feet (telapak kaki) ada di ujung kakimu. Feet punya ee di tengah.

ffe05785e3879e4f5511.en: Knees are in the middle of your legs.

1d5e355eb7a3f7ba235a.en: Toes have oe, and you have ten of them.
1d5e355eb7a3f7ba235a.id: Toes punya oe, dan jumlahnya ada sepuluh.

f2cac1f46a2f6bbc7ca0.en: The speaker said "rain". The letters ai make the long a sound.
f2cac1f46a2f6bbc7ca0.id: Orang itu mengucapkan "rain". Huruf ai membentuk bunyi a panjang.

9859b7f3b350261e3997.en: The word is rain. The letters ai make the long a sound.
9859b7f3b350261e3997.id: Kata itu adalah rain. Huruf ai membentuk bunyi a panjang.

6025dead5c078dfd74e0.en: The word is boat. The letters oa make the long o sound.
6025dead5c078dfd74e0.id: Kata itu adalah boat. Huruf oa membentuk bunyi o panjang.

647f852ded1ca9c5205e.en: Feet has the letters ee, which make the long e sound.
647f852ded1ca9c5205e.id: Feet punya huruf ee, yang membentuk bunyi e panjang.

01e336ffc1fae2a0e1c4.en: Fat has the short sound a.

c3a60eebf447c20a98ca.en: Fit has the short sound i.

abae0ef6a6661cdb1b9c.en: Ran has the letter a only.

07dc7868785a43b15eeb.en: Boat has the letters oa. It floats on water.
07dc7868785a43b15eeb.id: Boat punya huruf oa. Boat mengapung di air.

47ff1f45cea053afba46.en: Night has the letters igh. It has the same long i sound as the word nine.
47ff1f45cea053afba46.id: Night punya huruf igh. Bunyi i panjangnya sama dengan kata nine.

66f9528143fa8e5977b3.en: The word is snail. The letters ai make the long a sound.
66f9528143fa8e5977b3.id: Kata itu adalah snail. Huruf ai membentuk bunyi a panjang.

d13dd3cd1e48f96fd9dd.en: The word is see. The letters ee make the long e sound.
d13dd3cd1e48f96fd9dd.id: Kata itu adalah see. Huruf ee membentuk bunyi e panjang.

a556d0d0ef2e2b0a0738.en: Rain, tail and snail have ai. Goat, coat and road have oa.
a556d0d0ef2e2b0a0738.id: Rain, tail, dan snail punya ai. Goat, coat, dan road punya oa.

1aa3b52a1fad05dfc6c2.en: Tree has ee, light has igh, moon has oo and paint has ai.
1aa3b52a1fad05dfc6c2.id: Tree punya ee, light punya igh, moon punya oo, dan paint punya ai.

e1c8153e70008cc2576b.en: Sad has the short sound a.

e7977c3ba8c36edc5945.en: The speaker said moon. The middle sound is oo.
e7977c3ba8c36edc5945.id: Orang itu mengucapkan moon. Bunyi tengahnya adalah oo.

813379ed3189b8a45423.en: Ai makes the sound in rain.

c66be786b216161787ad.en: Oa makes the sound in boat.

3ce100fb08e8ddc29d1d.en: The word is tree. It has the vowel team ee.
3ce100fb08e8ddc29d1d.id: Kata itu adalah tree. Kata ini punya pasangan huruf vokal (vowel team) ee.

2538fa8da1dafb1b57a8.en: The word is boat. It has the vowel team oa.
2538fa8da1dafb1b57a8.id: Kata itu adalah boat. Kata ini punya pasangan huruf vokal (vowel team) oa.

b20415bb5aa826810eac.en: Nite is how it sounds, but it is not spelt that way.
b20415bb5aa826810eac.id: Nite memang sesuai bunyinya, tetapi ejaannya tidak begitu.

e304f70f8a82450cb0d0.en: Tray and rain have the long a sound. Cat has a short a.
e304f70f8a82450cb0d0.id: Tray dan rain punya bunyi a panjang. Cat punya a pendek.

1fef7f46da23f7d1557a.en: Tray has the long a sound.
1fef7f46da23f7d1557a.id: Tray punya bunyi a panjang (long a).

b765970e58e30a8192eb.en: Rain has the long a sound.
b765970e58e30a8192eb.id: Rain punya bunyi a panjang (long a).

e724c647b1497768e6d2.en: Tree has the vowel team ee.
e724c647b1497768e6d2.id: Tree punya pasangan huruf vokal (vowel team) ee.

2bee8b9b7dc5a0bee6f2.en: Rain is spelt r-ai-n. The ai makes the long a sound.
2bee8b9b7dc5a0bee6f2.id: Rain dieja r-ai-n. Huruf ai membentuk bunyi a panjang.

e0659b07e464eb22d23b.en: Tree has the letters ee. The word boat has oa.
e0659b07e464eb22d23b.id: Tree punya huruf ee. Kata boat punya oa.

1855d433d3ff20db3c5c.en: Boat is spelt b-oa-t. Oa makes the long o sound.
1855d433d3ff20db3c5c.id: Boat dieja b-oa-t. Oa membentuk bunyi o panjang.

7197e52cd91ae3a55709.en: Light is spelt l-igh-t. Igh makes the long i sound.
7197e52cd91ae3a55709.id: Light dieja l-igh-t. Igh membentuk bunyi i panjang.

a7f1a8022e09f4b44a14.en: Both words have the oo sound spelt with the letters oo.
a7f1a8022e09f4b44a14.id: Kedua kata itu punya bunyi oo yang ditulis dengan huruf oo.

0c8be28225d446446d13.en: Seed has the vowel team ee.
0c8be28225d446446d13.id: Seed punya pasangan huruf vokal (vowel team) ee.
